editorNotes.purpose: Original sentence-correction bank for Level 1 Stage 1, meeting the approved 20-item allocation only; not the complete stage bank.
editorNotes.reviewNotes: Original Grade 3 sentence-correction items covering agreement, tense, pronouns, punctuation, plurals, comparisons and sentence completeness. Requires editorial and pedagogical review before approval or publication.

questions.prompt: Mira and Rohan ___ to school together every day.

source.reference: Newly authored English Aptitude sentence-correction item for Level 1, Stage 1.

rights.basis: Original prompt and options authored for this project.

feedback.correct: The compound subject “Mira and Rohan” is plural, so “walk” is the correct verb.
feedback.incorrect: Read each option carefully. Check grammar, punctuation and meaning, then choose the complete and accurate sentence.

options: Mira and Rohan walk to school together every day.
Mira and Rohan walks to school together every day.
Mira and Rohan walking to school together every day.
Mira and Rohan is walk to school every day.
answerKey: Mira and Rohan walk to school together every day.
questions.explanation: The compound subject “Mira and Rohan” is plural, so “walk” is the correct verb.

options: We play outside after lunch yesterday.

We playing outside after lunch yesterday.
answerKey: We played outside after lunch yesterday.
questions.explanation: “Yesterday” signals the past, so the verb should be “played.”
